Generate uniform Color Scale input UI

Source: R/uniform_ui_inputs.R
uniform_colorscale_inputs_ui.Rd

Creates a standardized tagList of the inputs that set a continuous colour scale, for a plotly figure with a colorbar such as a heatmap:

Usage

uniform_colorscale_inputs_ui(ns, defaults = NULL)

Arguments

ns

A namespace function, typically created by NS(id).

defaults

A named list of default values for the inputs.

Value

A tagList containing the colour scale input UI elements.

Details

  • colorscale.colors - The five colour stops, lowest value first, as a multiColorPicker() (UI: "Color Scale", default: the "RdYlBu" preset). In defaults, five colours, named by stop or in order

  • colorscale.palette - The preset selected, one of "RdYlBu", "Jet", "Blue-White-Red", "Viridis", "Magma", or "Cividis". Set in defaults only

  • colorscale.reverse - Run the colours from high to low (UI: "Reverse Colors", default: FALSE)

  • colorscale.min - Value at the lowest colour (UI: "Scale Min", default: NA, the data's minimum)

  • colorscale.mid - Value at the middle colour (UI: "Scale Mid", default: NA, the centre of the limits)

  • colorscale.max - Value at the highest colour (UI: "Scale Max", default: NA, the data's maximum)

  • colorbar.title - Title of the colorbar (UI: "Colorbar Title", default: "Value")

Pass the inputs to resolve_colorscale(), and restore them with reset_colorscale_inputs(). The picker's five stops are fixed, so it needs no renderUI() and no setup_group_colors() store: read it directly, as isolate_fn(input$colorscale.colors).

The colorbar's fonts and visibility follow the Legend tab, through apply_legend_styling().

See also

resolve_colorscale(), reset_colorscale_inputs()

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

ns <- shiny::NS("plot1")
uniform_colorscale_inputs_ui(ns)
#> <div class="multi-color-picker shiny-input-container form-group is-compact " id="plot1-colorscale.colors" data-palettes="{&quot;RdYlBu&quot;:[&quot;#2C7BB6&quot;,&quot;#ABD9E9&quot;,&quot;#FFFFBF&quot;,&quot;#FDAE61&quot;,&quot;#D7191C&quot;],&quot;Jet&quot;:[&quot;#0000FF&quot;,&quot;#00FFFF&quot;,&quot;#80FF80&quot;,&quot;#FFFF00&quot;,&quot;#FF0000&quot;],&quot;Blue-White-Red&quot;:[&quot;#2166AC&quot;,&quot;#92C5DE&quot;,&quot;#F7F7F7&quot;,&quot;#F4A582&quot;,&quot;#B2182B&quot;],&quot;Viridis&quot;:[&quot;#440154&quot;,&quot;#3B528B&quot;,&quot;#21908C&quot;,&quot;#5DC863&quot;,&quot;#FDE725&quot;],&quot;Magma&quot;:[&quot;#000004&quot;,&quot;#51127C&quot;,&quot;#B63679&quot;,&quot;#FB8861&quot;,&quot;#FCFDBF&quot;],&quot;Cividis&quot;:[&quot;#00224E&quot;,&quot;#434E6C&quot;,&quot;#7D7C78&quot;,&quot;#BCAF6F&quot;,&quot;#FEE838&quot;]}" data-initial="{&quot;Lowest&quot;:&quot;#2C7BB6&quot;,&quot;Low&quot;:&quot;#ABD9E9&quot;,&quot;Middle&quot;:&quot;#FFFFBF&quot;,&quot;High&quot;:&quot;#FDAE61&quot;,&quot;Highest&quot;:&quot;#D7191C&quot;}" data-groups="[&quot;Lowest&quot;,&quot;Low&quot;,&quot;Middle&quot;,&quot;High&quot;,&quot;Highest&quot;]" data-default-palette="RdYlBu" data-compact="true">
